paper.title: On Series Involving Cubed Catalan Numbers
core_sections: Series involving fourth powers of Catalan numbers

encoded_claims.statement: Generalized Bauer-type family for 1/pi indexed by m
Ramanujan-like family for 1/pi^2 indexed by m
Special 1/pi^3 identity from central binomial cube series

verification_summary.exploratory_scan_note: Higher-m family scans are exploratory visualization outputs, not strict closed-form acceptance checks.

abstract_conclusion: The paper's theorem families can be compiled into executable numerical contracts.
Canonical explicit identities (Eq20/Eq24/Eq25) are reproducibly supported in this implementation.
Multi-dimensional visual spaces expose both local convergence speed and global argument geometry.
The Stage6/7/8 pipeline supports translating formal math claims into reproducible visual artifacts.
